data.name: TraderGen
data.teaser: A dependency/framework mod that lets anyone, including non-programmers, create custom traders for SPTarkov using simple JSON files.
data.description:
TraderGen - Custom Trader Framework

TraderGen is a server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone create custom traders using simple JSON files, no programming required.

What It Does

  • Loads trader packs from user/mods/TraderGen/traders/
  • Registers traders, assort items, loyalty levels, and custom quests automatically
  • Supports story quests with multiple objectives (kill, handover, survive/extract)
  • Handles all image routing and locale registration internally

Web Tool

Create trader packs visually with the TraderGen Tool — fill in forms, upload images, and export a ready-to-use zip.

Installation

  1. Drag the SPT folder from the mod archive into your SPT installation directory.
  2. Start the server. TraderGen loads automatically and waits for trader packs.

Making a Trader Pack

  1. Open the TraderGen Tool.
  2. Fill in trader details, loyalty levels, items, and optional quests.
  3. Click Export to download a zip.
  4. Drag the SPT folder into your SPT install to test (ALWAYS use a new temporary profile when testing).

Do not rename any files or images after exporting. The mod references them by their generated names (e.g., avatar.jpg, tpl_*.jpg) - renaming will break the pack.

In-Game Export Feature

This allows you to export weapon builds, as well as armour, rig setups, and even containers with items in them and import them into the web app to add to your trader, making the process far easier.

Read about it here.

Publishing a Trader Pack

The TraderGen Tool export zip is already structured for distribution — users just drag the SPT folder into their install directory.

When publishing:

  1. State the dependencies: Your add-on requires com.serenity.tradergen v2.0.3+ and com.wtt.commonlib v2.0.20+ (WTT - CommonLib)
  2. Do not include the TraderGen/WTT-CommonLib DLL or other authors’ packs in your zip
  3. Include your assets: Ensure assets/avatar.jpg and any quest icons are present — do not rename them, the mod references them by their generated names

Dependencies

  • SPTarkov 4.0.13
  • WTT - CommonLib 2.0.20+

More Information

View my framework mods and user created add-ons for them here.

See the full documentation, JSON reference, and examples in the GitHub README.
data.custom_ai_disclosure: I have been programming for 15 years as a hobby, I use AI to draft and create boilerplates, as well as descriptions. The code is thoroughly reviewed by me before anything is published.

versions.description:
## v2.3.0 Changelog
- **SPT 4.1 compatibility** - updated server and client for SPT 4.1.x
- **Not backward compatible** - this version requires SPT 4.1.x and will not work with SPT 4.0.x or earlier.

## v2.2.0 Changelog
- Assort items unlocked via quest are now properly integrated so they show within quest rewards
- Productions schemes can now also be set as a quest reward
- Web tool updated with a new `Schemes` tab for making custom hideout crafts
- Updated web tool so that assort items unlocked via quest in the assorts tab are auto synced to the quest reward section of the chosen quest

# v2.1.0 Changelog

**New quest objectives**

- Find Item - track picking up a specific item in raid. Supports custom quest items created with ItemGen (Coming out soon along with Map Editor Lite).
- Leave Item at Location - place any item in a custom zone without an animation, similar to the vanilla "Farming - Part 1" quest.


**Fixes**

- Fixed custom zones on Factory and Ground Zero so a single zone entry now works across both map variants (day/night, Sandbox/Sandbox_high).
- Added the ability to set any pre-requisite quest to unlock the trader if "Unlock by default" is false

**HOTFIX**
- Changed trader standing quest reward to use InvariantCulture

**HOTFIX**
- Hand in item objectives now correctly maps the item ID when no custom text is provided

**Mod:**
You can make zone specific quests now (early version):
- Visit specific locations Objective
- Place markers in designated areas Objective
- Kill in designated areas Objective

Trader insurance has now been implemented, also allowing to set the Min-Max return time, and the storage time.

Custom pocket sizes can now be set as a quest reward.

**Web App:**
- Added zone based quest objectives to the UI
- Updated assortment tab to allow easy ammo pack creation with auto fill
- If changing trader ID, the id's within the quests will now automatically match the trader ID
- Added settings UI for insurance (if enabled)

**Bug fixes:**
- Loyalty Coef levels now work
- Disabling "Buyer Enabled" now correctly disallows the trader to purchase items from the player

**Mod:**
- Allow setting quest objective for extract to use a specific extract only 
- Added ability to give stash expansion as a quest reward
- Added ability to give skill xp as a quest reward
- Added ability to give weapon/equipment builds as reward
- Added ability to lock item assorts behind certain quests
- Added ability to stack item assorts (e.g. GP coins in bag)
- __(STILL WIP)__ Ability to give fully custom pockets as a quest reward


**Web App:**
- Can now load vanilla traders for reference
- Small QOL features for item mapping
- Search bar in assortments and quests tabs for filtering
- Import from TraderGen added to quest item rewards
- Lock item assorts behind quest completion
- Added "amount" to item assorts/rewards

### Additions:
- Ability to state buy category whitelist for trader
- Ability to set dogtags as a barter option, with level/side
- Ability to make weapon presets in-game and export them to the tool
- Ability to export armour & rig setups in-game and export them to the tool
- Ability to export any item container with items in it and export them to the tool 
- Client patch for the last 3 above additions

### Minor Changes
- Currency & 0 value (handbook) items are auto prohibited for traders to buy to stop overflow errors
- Client patch overrides IsExchangeable to allow traders to sell gear with items inside (this does not work the other way around - you cannot accidentally sell a full bag)

### Web Tool:
- Added a few more slot ids in the attachment dropdown list
- Added Buy Categories drop down in trader general tab - defaults to all if none selected
- Added import button in assortment list page for weapon builds/armour etc from the client side patch

## How to use the export feature
Read [this](https://github.com/ShaneeexD/SPT-TraderGen#export-feature).

# ADDED:

## Advanced Quest Objectives
- Elimination quests with weapon restrictions (e.g. With Mosin Sniper)
- Elimination quests with equipment requirements (e.g. Wearing Paca)
- Distance-based kill requirements (Min/Max distance, cannot combine these)
- Headshot/body-part specific kills
- Time-of-day restrictions (day/night)
- Multiple combined restrictions (e.g. "Kill 5 Scavs on Woods at night using a PPSh")

## Raid-Specific Objectives
- Kill X enemies in a single raid
- Progress that resets if raid conditions are not met

## Trader Additions/Changes
- Ability to add and modify advanced items (custom weapon builds - armour with plates etc.)

## Tool
- Web app updated to apply for the updates (QOL features to come)

Much more to come, see the [roadmap](https://github.com/ShaneeexD/SPT-TraderGen/blob/main/Roadmap.md)
